title: Nacho Cheese Sauce
description: A quick and customizable nacho cheese sauce using any cheese you like.
steps: Mix the Alka-Seltzer tablets with the white distilled vinegar and let react until fizzing stops.
Pour the Alka-Seltzer mixture along with the cheese into a saucepan.
Heat over low heat, stirring until the cheese is completely melted.
Thin out the cheese sauce with a little bit of water to your desired consistency.
notes:
Use any cheese you prefer for customization.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/19xCaWNxx9/
